title: The data of question.asked
description: A question is recorded. Witness: the question in tehas question --json --after <id>. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

question.description: The store's own number of the question, tehas question's id.

kind.description: A park's question or a plan's, in the ports' shape.

blueprint.description: The blueprint, the factory API's issue.

cycle.description: The cycle that parked, on a park's question only.

choices.description: The choices, in order, while the store keeps the question's options: a planning question's options are kept only while the issue waits on it, so a planning question the issue no longer waits on has no choices.

label.description: What the choice does, for a person.
